questions.question: Ground state of the triangular J1 Heisenberg model?
questions.explanation: Three-sublattice 120-degree order with a strongly reduced moment, about 0.2.

questions.question: Roughly where is the J2/J1 spin-liquid window?
questions.explanation: DMRG (Zhu-White, Hu et al. 2015) and VMC; recent work favours the U(1) Dirac spin liquid.

questions.question: ED energy per site on the 12-site (3x4) torus at J2 = 0?
Same cluster at J2 = 0.1?
questions.explanation: J2 frustrates the 120-degree state and raises the energy.

questions.question: Which momentum peaks in S(q) for 120-degree order?
questions.explanation: Three-sublattice order is a K-point Bragg peak; stripe order (large J2) peaks at M.

questions.question: Why do DMRG studies use YC/XC cylinders?
options: the MPS entanglement grows with circumference, and the orientation selects which momenta are allowed
they are faster than tori for no reason
questions.explanation: Area law: S grows linearly with width W, so the cost grows as exp(W).
